dustry in India. 17. The bidder seeking EMD exemption, must submit the valid supporting docume nt for the relevant category as per GeM GTC with the bid. Operating system should be Genuine Windows 11 Home. 20. Connectivity – Integrated Wi-Fi and Blue tooth and integrated 10/100/1000 Mb ps Ethernet port. 21. Charger and Back pack by the OEM should be provided. .
